purpose: Company-level original-image asset library (objects by sha256, versioned catalog, per-project bindings). Template only: no secrets, no user paths.
activation: The production hooks (harvest / identity lock / reuse / keyframe / video reference) act only when QINGSHAN_STUDIO_ASSET_ROOT is set, or when this file says enabled=true (then the default root under $HOME is used). Every project on the machine points at the same root. The root must NOT be inside an engine clone, an episode folder or a temp folder.

backup.configured_by: environment only; nothing is configured here
backup.credentials: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, or STUDIO_ASSET_BACKUP_ACCESS_KEY_ID / STUDIO_ASSET_BACKUP_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, or STUDIO_ASSET_BACKUP_PROFILE (never in a file)
backup.unconfigured_behaviour: state UNCONFIGURED; local archive, resolve, bind, export, import, verify all work; no cloud claim is made
